summary_en: Maximum 2,000,000 shares (5.23% of shares outstanding) to be acquired on the Tokyo Stock Exchange at a total cost not to exceed ¥3.5 billion. Execution window: 12 Jun–24 Aug 2026. Open-market method. Reason: flexible capital policy and expanded shareholder returns.
title_en: Notice regarding decision on matters related to acquisition of treasury shares
translation_en_brief: On 11 June 2026, TKP Corporation's board of directors resolved to acquire up to 2,000,000 ordinary shares (5.23% of shares outstanding, ex-treasury) on the Tokyo Stock Exchange at a maximum aggregate cost of ¥3.5 billion. The acquisition window runs from 12 June to 24 August 2026, using open-market purchase method. The stated rationale is to enable flexible capital allocation and enhance shareholder returns in light of the company's balance sheet and operating cash flow position. As of end-May 2026, TKP held 4.4 million treasury shares against 38.2 million shares outstanding (ex-treasury).
